projects.name: Serione

projects.name: ClickChin / component builder
projects.summary: A Laravel API and Next.js editor for composing, previewing, and persisting landing pages.
projects.problem: Landing layouts needed a reusable content model and an editing surface rather than one-off pages.
projects.contribution: Implemented the Laravel landing and component API, with shared frontend and development tooling work. The full generation and deployment platform lives elsewhere.
projects.architecture: Laravel JSON endpoints persist landing configuration; a Next.js editor assembles component state and previews it in React.
projects.engineering_details: The public pair demonstrates an editor-to-API boundary, JSON persistence, authentication modules, and local Docker tooling. It does not include the complete exporter or hosted deployment system.

projects.name: AMIRAMIR Jewelry
projects.summary: A custom jewelry theme with a content model, account interactions, catalog views, and appointments.
projects.problem: A content-led jewelry site needed tailored product storytelling and customer interaction beyond a stock theme.
projects.contribution: Led theme architecture and substantial implementation across content modeling, settings, AJAX account flows, wishlist, and frontend behavior; collaborated with Solaiman Naderi.
projects.architecture: WordPress custom post type and taxonomies, metadata and settings, PHP templates, AJAX endpoints, and an appointment table.
projects.engineering_details: The public export has security hardening, neutral media, independent history, behavior checks, and a safe local Compose example. It is theme source, not a complete site.

projects.name: Anar360 integration
projects.summary: Catalog mapping from an external service into WooCommerce products and categories.
projects.problem: Commerce data from a separate catalog had to become maintainable WordPress product records.
projects.contribution: Built substantial parts of the API retrieval, category and attribute mapping, and WordPress/WooCommerce product update workflow with collaborators.
projects.architecture: A WordPress plugin uses service API responses, admin settings, WooCommerce objects, and product metadata to map catalog entities.
projects.engineering_details: The reviewed public export scopes the integration and admin authorization. Full historical production sync behavior and product variation support are not claimed.

projects.name: Panjere Studio
projects.summary: A studio theme for project, editorial, and contact content with reusable WordPress templates.
projects.problem: The studio needed a flexible publishing surface for work and editorial content.
projects.contribution: Implemented the majority of the audited theme repository, including PHP templates, project content structure, and contact functionality, with design and collaborator credit kept separate.
projects.architecture: Custom post type and taxonomy, template parts, meta boxes, contact handling, and optional Polylang integration.
projects.engineering_details: The public repository contains isolated theme source. The live site's Laboratory metrics/API implementation was not established by this theme export.

projects.name: TEBSEO
projects.summary: A custom marketing theme with responsive sections and a contact request workflow.
projects.problem: A service site needed a cohesive marketing frontend and a manageable lead workflow.
projects.contribution: Principal contributor to the available WordPress history; developed the theme and local development tooling alongside collaborators.
projects.architecture: WordPress PHP templates and hooks, Tailwind frontend, AJAX contact handler, and an administrator request view.
projects.engineering_details: The public export removes original configuration and client media, hardens the contact flow, and documents live-runtime limits.

projects.name: Panjere miniCli
projects.summary: A PHP command-line tool for WordPress setup and code-generation routines.
projects.problem: Repeated theme setup and custom content boilerplate slowed project starts.
projects.contribution: Implemented folder, Git, and WordPress service routines and custom post type/taxonomy generation in a collaborative CLI.
projects.architecture: Composer-based PHP commands invoke focused services for filesystem work, template cloning, and generated WordPress code.
projects.engineering_details: The public version documents command limits and tests the supported routines. A generic Git initialization command is not claimed.

projects.name: iGame PWA
projects.visibility: Public historical repository; rights review open
projects.summary: A Next.js client that coordinates customer, product, order, and wallet flows across two API boundaries.
projects.problem: The customer experience needed a responsive application over existing WordPress and another service API.
projects.contribution: Substantial work in the public Next.js/TypeScript client. The repository does not establish authorship of the backend services.
projects.architecture: Next.js app routes, feature components, Zustand state, and separate Axios clients for WordPress and another API host.
projects.engineering_details: A near-identical IranCP variant exists; it is treated as one engineering story. Existing client assets/configuration have unresolved publication and presentation issues.

projects.name: Amlak Arad panel
projects.visibility: Public historical repository; backend security review open
projects.summary: A React administrative interface connected to a separate WordPress API plugin.
projects.problem: Property administration needed forms and API-backed management views.
projects.contribution: Shared frontend implementation in the available React repository. Exact contract placement and the broader Next.js work are not established by this source.
projects.architecture: React UI modules, form validation, routing, and an Axios service boundary to a WordPress API.
projects.engineering_details: The related historical WordPress API needs authorization remediation before it can be endorsed as a current source example.
